source_snapshot.title: Al Ain to introduce Dh2 hourly paid parking in three sectors from October 26
source_snapshot.text: Al Ain: Motorists in Al Ain will have to pay Dh2 an hour to park in three sectors of the city from Monday, October 26, as authorities introduce paid parking across 1,455 spaces.Q Mobility announced that the charges would apply to parking spaces in Al Mutarad and the city centre, under the regulatory supervision of the Integrated Transport Centre (Abu Dhabi Mobility), part of the Department of Municipalities and Transport..Get updated faster and for FREE: Download the Gulf News app now - simply click here..The three sectors include designated parking spaces for People of Determination, as part of efforts to accommodate the needs of different groups.The introduction of paid parking comes amid growing demand for public parking spaces in Al Ain, driven by population growth and the expansion of commercial and service activities.Authorities aim to regulate parking use, improve traffic flow and make it easier for residents, visitors and employees to access businesses, facilities and services across the city.The hourly fee for standard parking spaces covered by the scheme will be Dh2. Motorists can pay through the Darb and TAMM applications.Q Mobility urged drivers to follow parking signs and regulations, use spaces only for their designated purposes and pay the applicable fees in accordance with the rules..Abu Dhabi parking guide: MAWAQiF fees, timings, permits and how to pay.Paid parking begins at Sharjah’s Aljada. Here’s what drivers will pay.Abu Dhabi activates paid parking in 3,921 Musaffah spaces.Q Mobility expands paid parking in new commercial sectors of Abu Dhabi

claims.claim: In Al Ain, paid parking will be introduced from October 26.
Paid parking will be implemented in three sectors of the city, including the city centre and Al Mutarad district.
The paid parking will cover 1455 parking spaces.
Paid parking spaces include designated spots for People of Determination (people with disabilities).
Payment for parking can be made through the Darb and TAMM applications.

title: Al Ain to introduce Dh2 hourly paid parking in three sectors from October 26
summary_ru: 🚗 В Аль-Айне с 26 октября вводят платную парковку 💳 В Аль-Айне с 26 октября начнёт действовать платная парковка в трёх зонах города, включая центр и район Аль-Мутарад. Оплата составит 2 дирхама в час за 1455 парковочных мест. Платные места включают специальные парковки для людей с ограниченными возможностями. Оплату можно будет производить через приложения Darb и TAMM.
